newsitem.title: USA: ITT pares headquarter staff to 75.
newsitem.headline: ITT pares headquarter staff to 75.

text.p: ITT Corp said it is will reduce its headquarters' staff to 75, from about 200, as part of a major head office reorganization.

ITT, which is the target of a $55 a share, $6.5 billion billion tender offer by Hilton Hotels Corp , said the reorganization was part of its strategy to raise shareholder value and improve profitability.
ITT said it was also reducing occupancy at its posh Avenue of the Americas headquarters in midtown Manhattan from 11 to five floors.
Rand Araskog, ITT's chairman and chief executive officer, said the action is needed to make the company more competitive.

He said the company was moving to ease transition problems for employees whose jobs are being eliminated and was offering enhanced severance packages and retirement benefits as well as outplacement services.
The staff cuts would result in a charge to ITT's first quarter earnings, according to a company spokesman.
He described the cuts as "a work in progress, but declined to state the amount involved in the charge.
